concept: Visual-first news poster. One huge hero dominates the top half so the image reads at ~300px thumbnail size; six story cards below carry one big vector icon, a two-word title and one big number each; a footer ticker adds three more stories. Direct response to the round-2 judge note that a dense-text timeline was hard to read at thumbnail size.
determinism: Fixed colours, fonts, coordinates; no randomness, clock or network. Two runs produce byte-identical PNGs.
format: 1024x1024 PNG, drawn in code with PIL (no external images, no network)
palette: Deep night-blue background with one high-contrast accent per story (red, orange, magenta, yellow, green, violet, cyan hero) — a bold magazine-cover look, deliberately unlike the flat navy timeline of round 2.

shots.description: Black masthead band with a red edge: 'FRIDAY 20 NOVEMBER 2026' in huge white capitals and a yellow 'THE WORLD TODAY' kicker, so the day is unmistakable at any size.
shots.why: Judge criterion 1: the image must name the day it sums up.

shots.description: Giant cyan cyclone spiral (concentric broken arcs with a calm eye) over teal sea bands with rain streaks, filling the right half of the hero panel; on the left, 'CYCLONE AKVAN' and the enormous yellow number '300,000 EVACUATED', with 'IN INDIA - ODISHA LANDFALL' beneath.
shots.why: The day's biggest human story (300,000 evacuated) and the most drawable visual; the spiral is recognisable even when shrunk to a thumbnail.

shots.description: Red card: a missile with a flame tail flying right, title 'KYIV HIT', big number '4 MISSILES'.
shots.why: Overnight ballistic-missile strike on Kyiv, the day's sharpest war story.

shots.description: Orange card: a quadcopter drone seen from above, title 'DRONES SHUT GENOA', big number '4 HOURS'.
shots.why: Unidentified drones closed a European airport — security story with a instantly readable icon.

shots.description: Magenta card: a landmark tower with a blast burst at its crown, title 'HOUTHI HIT RIYADH', big number '4 TARGETS'.
shots.why: Houthi strikes reaching the Saudi capital; the tower silhouette makes the city recognisable.

shots.description: Yellow card: a tanker hull with flames above it on a blue waterline, title 'TANKER BURNS', big label 'HORMUZ MINE'.
shots.why: Mine strike on a tanker by the Strait of Hormuz — energy/shipping story, flame icon reads at any size.

shots.description: Green card: rising bar chart with a yellow arrow, title 'ANTHROPIC DEBUTS', big number '+17%'.
shots.why: First purely AI company to list publicly — the day's tech/business story, told with one number.

shots.description: Violet card: a game controller, title 'GTA 6 BEATS ODYSSEY', big number '$1.8 BILLION'.
shots.why: Culture/entertainment breadth: GTA 6 passing The Odyssey's box-office run is the day's pop-culture milestone.

shots.description: Dark-red footer band, two short lines: 'ALSO TODAY: KOREA EXPORTS TOP $1 TRILLION' and 'TAIWAN CALMS MARKETS - EUROPE READY FOR RUSSIA TALKS'.
shots.why: Adds three more consequential stories (economy, markets, diplomacy) without adding another row of small text.

title: Friday 20 November 2026 — the world in one picture
